description: Files that define the merge and deployment gates or the security controls. A PR changing any of them is judged by the checks it modifies (Jenkins runs the PR's own Jenkinsfile), so it is reviewed and merged manually, never auto-merged. Read by scripts/ci/impacted-tests.ts (report) and, from main only, by .github/workflows/gate-guard.yml (enforcement). Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions matched against repository-relative paths.
